body.interpretation: Read the 64-bit field at [param_2 + 0x20]; compute field + (field != 0) and write it back (a non-zero-guarded increment: 0 stays 0, n!=0 becomes n+1). Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xda0 (entry index 436). No other side effects, no return value. The reflected exec entry is only this counter side-effect plus the dispatch; the real handler body lives in the vtable slot.
